label: preparing
what: A bridge-or-port change is being planned/discussed around the bakery, but the details and whether it is truly underway remain unconfirmed. The reports name the baker, innkeeper, freight, and neighbour as present; the innkeeper and builder knowingly arranged the separate great-hall lighting inspection gathering, not the bridge/port plan itself. The confirmed preparation is the lighting inspection of eight lanterns at 18:00, involving mayor, builder, and secretary; it is an approved appointment rather than something kept from the mayor.
